items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well, at that time we had Bob Thomas on the trombone and Tom Jefferson on trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, we'd done that for quite a long time. And I guess you came back then, you made the English trip, did you? Yeah, it was, yeah, we went, it was from there. And we was working at the Sinton Hotel. Mm-hmm. When we got news that we was going overseas. Mm-hmm. So, we came on back home after we finished the engagement with Andrew Sinton. We came back home, that's the time I was trying to find Russell. Yeah. To see if I get our passport. Passport. Because George had his, you see. Yeah. Whether it was Jack, Howard,…
That was the band that made those records on Cavalier, remember? Yeah, Cavalier.
